name: Digital Control of Power Electronic Systems
description: Basics of digital electronics – latch, flop-flops, multiplexer, demultiplexer, comparators, state machines, number formats, digital signal processing (DSP) platform. Discrete domain control system – Z transformation, digital filters (finite impulse response and infinite impulse response), mapping between s-plane and z-plane, numerical methods for integration. Discrete time modelling of DC-DC converters - small signal state space model, discrete time small signal modelling, time-invariant topology equivalence and modified Z-transform. Digital implementation of PWMs – sine PWM, space vector PWM, level shifted carrier PWM for multilevel converters. Digital control design - voltage and current mode control, sampling, aliasing and quantization effects, loop delay sources, limitations of average models for digital control, digital compensators, system level compensator design, PID compensator realization structures (parallel, direct, cascade). Grid tied converter control in digital platform – phase locked loop (PLL), active front end rectifier, boost PFC, model predictive control.
